name.en-US: The Life and Revelations of St. Gertrude
name.pt-BR: Vida e Revelações de Santa Gertrudes

description.en-US: Cusack's 1870 English version of the Legatus divinae pietatis: a life of Gertrude drawing on Book I and the Latin lives, then Books II-V in her own and her sisters' words. Rearranged and abridged, so it is a separate book from the Latin.
description.pt-BR: A versão inglesa de Cusack (1870) do Legatus divinae pietatis: uma vida de Gertrudes baseada no Livro I e nas biografias latinas, e em seguida os Livros II a V. Reorganizada e resumida, por isso é um livro à parte do latim.

sources.edition: The Life and Revelations of Saint Gertrude, Virgin and Abbess, of the Order of St. Benedict, London: Burns & Oates, 1870 (translated from the Latin of Canteleu, 1662).
sources.description: Internet Archive OCR. Contents pages, running heads, page-foot notes and the appended prayer manual and index are dropped; chapters are numbered by order within each part (research/sourcing/_scripts/gertrude_cusack.py). Book I is not translated: its substance is in Part I.
